title: ZTIE behavioral-telemetry data contract (v1)
description: The derived, bounded BEHAVIORAL TELEMETRY produced by the Story 2.4 instrumentation of the Story 2.3 DYNAMIC lane (RD-030) for one intake artifact detonated host-native on the ephemeral EC2, and the EIGHTH envelope kind on the Forensic -> Hub RD-013 gate. While the artifact ran host-native (NO Docker, RD-001) the ephemeral host captured its own runtime behavior with a pre-baked host tool (strace); the FULL trace stays in Forensic (RD-009) behind a pointer, and only this bounded, derived SUMMARY crosses: capture health, bounded syscall / network / filesystem counts, and a capped sample of the most-salient events. Network capture records outbound connection ATTEMPTS (INTENT) — in the isolated VPC the host has no egress, so attempts fail but the attempt is the signal. All behavioral timings are RELATIVE monotonic offsets (ms) from detonation start, never a wall clock (only the envelope 'captured_at' stamp is wall-clock, for audit correlation). It CAPTURES raw behavior; SANITIZATION (entropy scrub / noise suppress / <=25K-token truncation) is Story 2.5 and is NOT in this contract. It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious field anywhere; counts/samples/capture-health are EVIDENCE and the verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT_VERSION) + a UNIQUE 'behavior' discriminator that does not collide with any other envelope kind.

contract_version.description: Behavioral-telemetry-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the Hub validator (BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this envelope kind versions independently of the other seven kinds (never rides the shared CONTRACT_VERSION). The Hub rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this telemetry is for. The Hub upserts the telemetry onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body that was detonated. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub rejects telemetry whose sha256 does not match the tracked record.

captured_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the orchestrator finished handling this run's capture in Forensic. This is the ONLY wall-clock field — all BEHAVIORAL timings are relative monotonic offsets (see behavior.capture.*_offset_ms).

behavior.description: The derived behavioral telemetry: the capture facts (tool, health, host-native, relative offsets, Forensic trace pointer) and the three bounded summaries (syscalls, network, filesystem). It REFERENCES — never duplicates — the full trace (RD-009). EVIDENCE only; NO verdict anywhere. When capture_status is 'not_run' / 'tool_unavailable', the three summaries are absent (there was nothing to summarize) but the capture facts still record the gap explicitly.

lane.description: The lane this telemetry belongs to. Always 'dynamic_detonation' (behavior is captured during the dynamic run).

capture.description: The capture facts for this run: which host-native tool ran, whether it was available, how the capture ended, and the RELATIVE monotonic offsets (ms from detonation start) at which capture started/stopped. host_native + no_docker are asserted constants (RD-001) — capture always ran on the same ephemeral host as the detonation, over SSM, never in a container.

capture_tool.description: The host-native capture tool used (RD-030: 'strace'), or 'none' when no capture tool was available on the host (degraded case, recorded explicitly).

capture_status.description: How the capture ended (captured / tool_unavailable / capture_error / not_run). EVIDENCE of capture HEALTH — never a verdict about the artifact. A missing capture is RECORDED here, never a silent gap.

host_native.description: Always true. Capture ran host-native on the ephemeral EC2, driven over SSM (RD-001) — never in the Hub.

no_docker.description: Always true. No Docker / container was used for capture (RD-001 — a container would distort behavioral telemetry). Capture ran directly on the ephemeral host.

capture_started_offset_ms.description: RELATIVE monotonic offset in milliseconds from detonation start at which capture began. A relative clock only (RD: no wall clock for behavioral timings).

capture_stopped_offset_ms.description: RELATIVE monotonic offset in milliseconds from detonation start at which capture ended. A relative clock only.

trace_truncated.description: True iff the FULL host trace was larger than what was captured / summarized (the full trace still stays in Forensic behind the pointer). A capture-completeness fact, not a verdict.

trace_s3_bucket.description: Forensic S3 bucket holding the FULL behavioral trace (RD-009 — the full trace stays in Forensic; only the bounded summary + this pointer cross). Absent when no trace was captured.

trace_s3_key.description: Forensic S3 key of the full behavioral trace (traces/<intake_id>/behavior-trace.txt).

error_reason.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable reason when capture_status is 'capture_error' / 'tool_unavailable' (e.g. 'strace not present on host'). Never raw content.

syscalls.description: The bounded SYSCALL summary derived from the host trace. EVIDENCE of what the artifact asked the kernel to do. Bounded: a total count + a capped top-N of the most-frequent syscall names by count. The full per-call trace stays in Forensic (RD-009) behind the pointer. NOT a verdict.

total.description: Total number of syscalls observed in the trace (bounded count).

distinct.description: Optional number of DISTINCT syscall names observed.

top.description: Capped top-N of the most-frequent syscall names (name + count), ordered by count descending. Bounded sample for a quick glance / a Phase-3 seed; the full trace stays in Forensic.

name.description: A syscall name observed in the trace (e.g. 'openat', 'connect').

count.description: How many times this syscall was observed.

network.description: The bounded NETWORK summary derived from the host trace. In the isolated VPC the host has NO egress, so outbound connection ATTEMPTS fail — but the ATTEMPT is the signal (INTENT), so this records attempts, not only completed connections. EVIDENCE of what the artifact reached for. NOT a verdict.

connect_attempts.description: Total number of outbound connection ATTEMPTS observed (connect/sendto/etc.), whether or not they succeeded. In the isolated VPC these fail — the attempt itself is the signal of INTENT.

distinct_destinations.description: Optional number of DISTINCT destinations the attempts targeted.

dns_lookups.description: Optional number of DNS-lookup-shaped operations observed (name resolution attempts). Bounded count.

destinations.description: Capped sample of DISTINCT connection destinations the artifact attempted (host:port or ip:port strings + an attempt count + whether ANY attempt to it connected — false in the isolated VPC). Bounded sample; the full trace stays in Forensic. Inert strings, never resolved or dialed by the Hub.

destination.description: The destination the artifact attempted to reach (host:port / ip:port), as observed in the trace. Inert; recorded as EVIDENCE of intent, never contacted.

attempts.description: How many outbound attempts targeted this destination.

connected.description: True iff ANY attempt to this destination actually connected. In the isolated detonation VPC this is expected to be false (no egress) — a true here past containment would itself be salient EVIDENCE.

filesystem.description: The bounded FILESYSTEM summary derived from the host trace. EVIDENCE of what the artifact touched on disk (creates / writes / deletes / renames / permission changes). Bounded: operation-class counts + a capped sample of the most-salient paths (writes/creates/deletes). The full trace stays in Forensic (RD-009). NOT a verdict.

total_ops.description: Total number of filesystem operations observed (bounded count).

creates.description: Optional count of create-class operations (creat / O_CREAT).

paths.description: Capped sample of the most-salient filesystem paths the artifact touched (path + the operation class + a touch count). Bounded sample; the full trace stays in Forensic. Inert strings, never opened by the Hub.

path.description: A filesystem path the artifact touched, as observed in the trace. Inert; recorded as EVIDENCE, never opened.

op.description: The operation class observed for this path.

count.description: Optional number of times this path was touched with this operation class.
